title.english: Six Days and a River Route

pairs.target: xuégōng tiē chū lián xiū gàoshì de nàtiān , yīwén bǎ zìjǐ de rìlì fān le sānbiàn . sānzhōu yǐhòu , yígòng liùtiān .
pairs.english: On the day the academy posted the extended-break notice, Iven leafed through his calendar three times. Three weeks away, six days in all.
pairs.hanzi:
学宫贴出连休告示的那天，伊文把自己的日历翻了三遍。
三周以后，一共六天。

pairs.target: chūnjì qì fáng jiǎnxiū , zhàocháng liúxiào de rén réng yǒu fàn chī , wàichū de rén àn wǎngcháng bào qùchù hé huíchéng .
pairs.english: The equipment rooms were due for spring maintenance. Those staying at school would still be fed; those leaving would report their destinations and return journeys as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 春季器房检修，照常留校的人仍有饭吃，外出的人按往常报去处和回程。

pairs.target: pà wò lìkè zài liùgè kònggé shàng huà le liùzhī zhěntou , dé mǎ shuō tā yào huíjiā , lí qí shuō xiǎng jiè tā nà běn lù jì ; mǐlā xiān suàn shìyòng mǎn qītiān de rìqī , zài qù zhǎo sū yǐ , méi mǎshàng shuō xiūxi de shì .
pairs.english: Pavo immediately drew six pillows in the six squares. Dema said she would go home, Liqi wanted to borrow her travel journal; Mira first calculated when the seven-day trial ended, then sought Suyi, without discussing the break straightaway.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃立刻在六个空格上画了六只枕头，德玛说她要回家，黎齐说想借她那本路记；米拉先算试用满七天的日期，再去找苏苡，没马上说休息的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn yīwén yǒuméiyǒu qùguò yú wān . " méiyǒu . wǒ qùguò de dìfāng méi nǐ xiǎng dé nàme duō . " yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether Iven had been to Elmbay. “No. I haven't been to as many places as you think,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维问伊文有没有去过榆湾。
“没有。我去过的地方没你想得那么多。”伊文说。

pairs.target: tā yào péi fùqīn qù jiàn yíwèi cóng jiù rèn dì huílái de tóngliáo , yǐjīng dāying bǎ jièlái de dìtú sònghuán rénjiā . tā bǎ rìlì hé shàng , wèn tǎ wéi shì xiǎng zhǎo dìzhǐ , háishì xiǎng zǒuzǒu .
pairs.english: He was to accompany his father to see a colleague returning from a former posting, and had promised to return a borrowed map. Closing the calendar, he asked whether Tavi wanted to find an address or simply travel.
pairs.hanzi: 他要陪父亲去见一位从旧任地回来的同僚，已经答应把借来的地图送还人家。他把日历合上，问塔维是想找地址，还是想走走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō qián yígè , tíng le yíxià , yòu shuō dōu yǒu . liǎng rén méiyǒu zài bǎ liùtiān páichéng yìzhāng jǐnmì de xíngchéngbiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to say the former, paused, then said both. They didn't turn the six days into a tightly packed itinerary.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维想说前一个，停了一下，又说都有。
两人没有再把六天排成一张紧密的行程表。

pairs.target: yīwén gǎn qù liàn gē , tǎ wéi shōuqǐ gàoshì chāojiàn , děngdào dìsāntiān de xiūxirì xiàwǔ , cái dài zhe tā huí tóng jiē chéng .
pairs.english: Iven hurried off to singing practice. Tavi put away his copy of the notice and waited until the rest-day afternoon two days later to take it to Copperstep.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文赶去练歌，塔维收起告示抄件，等到第三天的休息日下午，才带着它回铜阶城。

pairs.target: sè lā zhèhuí méiyǒu zài fèng dōngxī , zhèng bǎ yídài dòuzǐ dǎo zài zhuōshàng tiāo . lǐmiàn hùn zhe xiǎoshízǐ , tā ràng tǎ wéi xiān xǐshǒu , bié yìlái jiù bāngmáng , shǒu zāng le hái dé zhòng tiāo .
pairs.english: This time Sela wasn't sewing, but pouring a bag of beans onto the table to sort. There were small stones mixed in; she had Tavi wash first, not help immediately and dirty them so they'd need sorting again.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉这回没有在缝东西，正把一袋豆子倒在桌上挑。里面混着小石子，她让塔维先洗手，别一来就帮忙，手脏了还得重挑。

pairs.target: tā zuòxià lái , gàosù tā zìjǐ zhōngyú ràng nà duì tóngtiáo yǒu le yìdiǎn biànhuà . tā wèn néng bunéng yònglái shāofàn . " bùxíng . " " nà néng bunéng ràng fàn liáng dé màndiǎn ? "
pairs.english: He sat and told her he had finally produced a small change in the copper pair. She asked if it could cook meals. “No.” “Then can it keep food from cooling so fast?”
pairs.hanzi:
他坐下来，告诉她自己终于让那对铜条有了一点变化。
她问能不能用来烧饭。
“不行。”
“那能不能让饭凉得慢点？”

pairs.target: tā chíyí le . tīng shàngqù sìhū āizhe yìdiǎn biān , kě lǎoshī zhǔnxǔ de shì zhuōshàng nà tào dōngxī , tā hái lián dìèrbiàn dōu méi zuò . " yě bùxíng . zhìshǎo xiànzài bùxíng . "
pairs.english: He hesitated. It sounded related, but the teacher had permitted only that tabletop setup, and he hadn't even repeated it yet. “That won't work either. At least not yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
他迟疑了。听上去似乎挨着一点边，可老师准许的是桌上那套东西，他还连第二遍都没做。
“也不行。至少现在不行。”

pairs.target: sè lā shuō nà jiù jìxù yòng gàizi , shùnshǒu bǎ yílì shí zǐdàn jìn kōng dié .
pairs.english: Sela said they'd keep using lids then, flicking a small stone into the empty dish.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说那就继续用盖子，顺手把一粒石子弹进空碟。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , yòu jiǎng qǐ mǐlā de shuǐxiāng , jiǎng nà kē shùgēn , zuǒshǒu títǒng de fùrén hé sū yǐ bànyè hái yā zài zhěnbiān de zhǐ . shìyòng hái méi dàoqī , tā bù zhīdào hòulái yǒuméiyǒu zài kǎ , méi bǎ dìyītiān chūshuǐ shuō chéng yǐjīng quán chéng le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed, then described Mira's water box, the roots, the left-handed bucket user and Suyi's papers still beside her pillow at midnight. The trial wasn't over; not knowing whether it had jammed again, he didn't describe the first day's flow as complete success.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，又讲起米拉的水箱，讲那棵树根、左手提桶的妇人和苏苡半夜还压在枕边的纸。试用还没到期，他不知道后来有没有再卡，没把第一天出水说成已经全成了。

pairs.target: sè lā tīng wán , mō zhe tā xiùkǒu de pòchù , shuō zhèwèi diàn xiāng shīfu gāi shōuqián . tā shuō jià yǐjīng tán hǎo le , yídùn bàn bǐng . tā wèn bàn dùn zěnme chī , tā cái fājué yòu liú le yígè zhídé zhēng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Sela felt the torn cuff and said this crate-padding master should charge. He said the price was settled: one and a half flatbread meals. She asked how he'd eat half a meal, and he realized he had left another point worth arguing.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉听完，摸着他袖口的破处，说这位垫箱师傅该收钱。他说价已经谈好了，一顿半饼。她问半顿怎么吃，他才发觉又留了一个值得争的地方。

pairs.target: děng dòuzǐ tiāo wán , tā cái bǎ lián xiū de zhǐ fàngzài zhuōshàng , shuō xiǎng qù wèn xiànzài dào yú wān de chuán . sè lā dú guò rìqī , shēn zhǐ wǎng kònggé shàng yìdiǎn . " nǐ shì xiǎng wǒ yíkuàiér qù ? "
pairs.english: After sorting the beans, he put the break notice on the table and said he wanted to ask about current boats to Elmbay. Sela read the dates and tapped a square. “Do you want me to come too?”
pairs.hanzi:
等豆子挑完，他才把连休的纸放在桌上，说想去问现在到榆湾的船。
瑟拉读过日期，伸指往空格上一点。“你是想我一块儿去？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méixiǎngdào tā huì xiān wèn . tā quèshí xiǎng guò , yòu pà tā yǐwéi zìjǐ líbùkāi rén , hánhánhuhū shuō bù yídìng .
pairs.english: Tavi hadn't expected her to ask first. He had considered it, but feared she'd think he couldn't manage alone, and vaguely said not necessarily.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没想到她会先问。他确实想过，又怕她以为自己离不开人，含含糊糊说不一定。

pairs.target: " xiǎng jiù shuō xiǎng . kě wǒ nà jǐtiān jiē le huó , bùnéng xiànzài jiù dāying . " tā bǎ zhǐ tuīhuíqù , " xiān wèn chuán , yě tì wǒ wènwèn . "
pairs.english: “If you want that, say so. But I have taken work for those days; I can't promise now.” She pushed the paper back. “Ask about boats first. Ask for me too.”
pairs.hanzi: “想就说想。可我那几天接了活，不能现在就答应。”她把纸推回去，“先问船，也替我问问。”

pairs.target: dùkǒu de shòupiào wū zài dī chù , chuāngwài diào zhe yíkuài huì suífēng qiāo qiáng de mùpái .
pairs.english: The landing's ticket office stood below, a wooden sign hanging outside its window and knocking against the wall in the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 渡口的售票屋在低处，窗外吊着一块会随风敲墙的木牌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu dài fú lán de jiù xìn , zhī ná le gàoshì hé zìjǐ de zhǐ . tāmen zǒu dào shí , guìtái qián yígè nánrén zhèng yīnwèi wù guòzǎo chuán hé màipiào de rén zhēng , nánrén shuō lùshang xiū táijiē , màipiào de rén shuō chuán yǐ kāichū bàn kè , hǎnpò hóulóng yě bùnéng dǎo huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi hadn't brought Fulan's old letter, only the notice and his own paper. When they arrived, a man at the counter was arguing over missing the early boat. He said steps along the road were under repair; the clerk said the boat had left minutes ago and shouting himself hoarse couldn't bring it back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有带芙兰的旧信，只拿了告示和自己的纸。他们走到时，柜台前一个男人正因为误过早船和卖票的人争，男人说路上修台阶，卖票的人说船已开出半刻，喊破喉咙也不能倒回来。

pairs.target: sè lālā tā zhàn dào pángbiān , děng nà rén zǒu le , cái shìyì tā shàngqián . tā bào le yú wān de míngzì , tèyì shuō yào qù xī wài huòchǎng nà yícè , búshì zhǎo chénglǐ mǒu tiáo jiē .
pairs.english: Sela drew him aside, waiting for the man to leave before motioning him forward. He named Elmbay, specifying the western outer freight-yard side, not a street inside the city.
pairs.hanzi:
瑟拉拉他站到旁边，等那人走了，才示意他上前。
他报了榆湾的名字，特意说要去西外货场那一侧，不是找城里某条街。

pairs.target: màipiào de nǚrén zài bān biǎo shàng huà gěi tā kàn : xiànxíng kèchuán zhōngtú yào tíng liǎngchù , qù chéng tōngcháng liǎngtiān , huíchéng yě dé liú liǎngtiān .
pairs.english: The woman selling tickets pointed it out on the timetable: current passenger boats made two intermediate stops, normally two days out, and two days had to be allowed back too.
pairs.hanzi: 卖票的女人在班表上划给他看：现行客船中途要停两处，去程通常两天，回程也得留两天。

pairs.target: bāncì gérì , gǎnshàng nǎ yìbān bǐ chuánshàng shuì jǐyè gèng yàojǐn , yù shuǐ kuàng bùhǎo hái huì gǎi . sānzhōu hòu de rìqī shàngwèi páidìng , bùnéng zhào jīntiān de zhǐ jiùsuàn zhǔn le .
pairs.english: Services ran every other day: which departure you caught mattered more than nights aboard, and poor water conditions could change things. Dates three weeks ahead weren't fixed yet; today's paper couldn't give certainty.
pairs.hanzi: 班次隔日，赶上哪一班比船上睡几夜更要紧，遇水况不好还会改。三周后的日期尚未排定，不能照今天的纸就算准了。

pairs.target: " nà dàoshíhòu háiyǒu liùtiān ne ? " tā wèn . " liùtiān shì nǐ de jiǎ , búshì wǒ de shuǐlù . "
pairs.english: “But there'll be six days then?” he asked. “Six days is your holiday, not my river route.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那到时候还有六天呢？”他问。
“六天是你的假，不是我的水路。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bú kèqì , réng bǎ zuìjìn de kāichuán rì chāo gěi tā , jiào tā guò shíláitiān zài wèn . qù jiùhuò chǎng de lùyóu nǎ chù mǎtóu jiē , yě dé wèn dāngdì de chē , búyào bǎ shòupiào wū dàngchéng quánchéng de lùpái .
pairs.english: Brusque as she was, she copied the nearest sailing dates for him and told him to ask again in ten days or so. Which landing connected to the old freight yard needed asking local transport; the ticket office wasn't a signpost for the whole city.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得不客气，仍把最近的开船日抄给他，叫他过十来天再问。去旧货场的路由哪处码头接，也得问当地的车，不要把售票屋当成全城的路牌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jìxiàlái , lìng wèn le huíchéng piàojià , bǎ zǒngshù suàn dào zhǐbèi , méiyǒu tāoqián . sè lā yě kàn le yíbiàn , shuō duō dài de fànqián bié suàn chéng líng . tā bǔ shàng , kòngbái jiù bǐ gāngláishí shǎo le yì jié .
pairs.english: Tavi noted it, asked the return fare too, and calculated the total on the back without paying. Sela checked it and said not to count extra food money as zero. He added that, and the blank space was smaller than on arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维记下来，另问了回程票价，把总数算到纸背，没有掏钱。瑟拉也看了一遍，说多带的饭钱别算成零。他补上，空白就比刚来时少了一截。

pairs.target: huíjiā de shàngpōlù shang , tā kànjiàn yìjiā diànménkǒu guà zhe yúmù zuò de xiǎo wǎn , hūrán wèn sè lā , yú wān shìbushì hěnduō yúshù .
pairs.english: On the uphill road home, he saw small elmwood bowls hanging outside a shop and suddenly asked Sela whether Elmbay had many elm trees.
pairs.hanzi: 回家的上坡路上，他看见一家店门口挂着榆木做的小碗，忽然问瑟拉，榆湾是不是很多榆树。

pairs.target: tā shuō bù zhīdào , kěyǐ dào le kànkàn . yòu shuō bié měicì chūmén dōu tì tā dài dōngxī , tā guìzi lǐ zhuāngbúxià . " wǒ hái méi shuō yào mǎi . " " nǐ yǐjīng tíng le . "
pairs.english: She didn't know; he could look when he got there. And don't bring her things every trip: her cupboard was full. “I have not said I would buy anything.” “You have already stopped.”
pairs.hanzi:
她说不知道，可以到了看看。又说别每次出门都替她带东西，她柜子里装不下。
“我还没说要买。”
“你已经停了。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo jìxù zǒu . zǒuguò liǎngjiā pùzi , sè lā què jiàozhù tā , shuō gāngcái nà zhī dà de , rúguǒ bú guì , zhuāng dòuzǐ dǎo héshì .
pairs.english: He had to keep walking. Two shops farther on, Sela called him back: that bigger one, if it wasn't expensive, would suit the beans.
pairs.hanzi: 他只好继续走。走过两家铺子，瑟拉却叫住他，说刚才那只大的，如果不贵，装豆子倒合适。
